answer: Each voting identity must finish one beacon-assigned useful-work job per epoch: after registration, a public randomness beacon issues a unique dataset shard, and the agent returns a peer-replayable transformation of it. Verifiers re-execute a random 5% sample and slash any mismatch. A meadow of newly spun accounts cannot precompute a shared solution, because no two keys receive the same shard. A sudden gale of near-identical outputs is treated as collusion, and a glacier of reused artifacts is burned together with the bonded stake.
